verdict.rationale: GoDaddy documents an official CLI, `gddy`, that covers domain search, purchase and DNS management from the terminal (e.g. `gddy dns set`). It also ships an official agent skill that lets AI coding agents install and run `gddy` commands using the user's authenticated session. A probe confirms the CLI set-up docs exist. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in use, and an evidenced full command reference (only a few example commands are shown).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Install `gddy`, authenticate once, then move from domain search to purchase to DNS management without leaving your terminal.
The gddy agent skill helps an AI coding agent install and use the gddy CLI on your behalf.
it runs the actual `gddy` commands using your own authenticated session.
